description:
## Problem
The pattern `URI.parse(url) rescue nil` appears in 4+ places in fetcher.cr:
- `fetch_loop` line ~55 (current_uri init)
- `fetch_loop` line ~63 (inside loop body)
- `handle_redirect_action` line ~127
- `gray_fallback_url` line ~208

This is a DRY violation and the silent nil swallowing makes debugging harder.

## Proposal
Add a `parse_uri_safe(url : String) : URI?` private method to Fetcher (or extract to a shared utility module):
- Returns URI on success, nil on parse failure
- Optionally logs the parse failure via config.debug/error
- Replace all `URI.parse(url) rescue nil` occurrences with this method

The existing `parse_uri(url)` that raises already exists but is only used in `fetch_single`. Consider whether both are needed or if one can unify them.

## Benefits
- DRY: single point of change for URI parsing behavior
- Consistent error handling for malformed URLs
- Easier to add logging or metrics for parse failures
title: Eliminate URI.parse rescue nil duplication in Fetcher
